description.value:
A compact, 5-foot sphere of crackling energy materializes in an unoccupied space within range and persists for the duration. Any creature ending its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 lightning damage, half as much on a success.

As a bonus action, you can shift the sphere up to 30 feet; if you drive it into a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 kinetic damage on a failure or half on a success, and the sphere halts for the rest of the turn. The sphere can be guided over obstacles up to 5 feet tall and across gaps up to 10 feet wide, ignites unattended flammable material it touches, and casts bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20 feet.

Cast with a slot of 3rd level or higher, both the lightning and kinetic damage increase by 1d6 per slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: EC Powers — Dark Side Powers, Level 2
